# Accepted dependency advisories for the CI pip-audit gate.
#
# One advisory ID per line; `pip-audit --ignore-vuln <ID>` is passed for each.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Policy: the gate must stay RED for anything not listed here, so every entry
# needs a one-line reason. Entries are transitive ML dependencies (accelerate /
# ragas and its diskcache) with no published fix. The transformers block was
# retired on 2026-10-17: the 5.20.1 migration cleared all six advisories (four
# fixed in the 5.x line, two not applicable to 5.x) and pip-audit reports zero
# hits for it. setuptools' entry was retired the same day (84.0.0 > 83.0.0).
# Re-check this list whenever uv.lock is upgraded.
PYSEC-2026-3804  # accelerate — transitive (transformers stack), no fix in the 1.x line
PYSEC-2026-2447  # diskcache — transitive via ragas, no fix published
PYSEC-2026-3046  # ragas — transitive eval dep, no fix published
